Your first week at Morrow Repair Club

Wednesdays, 18:00-20:30, Eastbank Library workshop room. Arrive at 17:45 for your first-session orientation. No prior repair experience is required.

PrepareFirst sessionSafety

Before arriving

  • Read the safety notes below.
  • Bring closed-toe shoes.

Tools, eye protection, and a name badge are provided.

Your first session

  1. Meet the session coordinator at the welcome table.
  2. Join the 15-minute safety tour.
  3. Shadow an experienced volunteer.

After the tour, beginners may sort tools, document repairs, or help with fabric mending.

Safety boundaries

Only trained volunteers may work on mains-powered electrical devices. Never plug in an unknown device.

Ask the session coordinator before using an unfamiliar tool, handling a damaged battery, or continuing a repair that feels unsafe.

Make the session work for you

Access and breaks

Breaks are welcome at any time. The room has step-free access and an accessible toilet nearby. A quieter table is available for documentation work.

Before leaving

Return tools, label unfinished repairs with the coordinator, and share one thing learned.

After two sessions, discuss training interests with the coordinator. There is no required weekly commitment.
